capabilities: Render directory structure diagrams from Markdown lists in code blocks
extras: Feature requests are directed to the underlying dirtreeist library, which this plugin depends on.
problem: Obsidian cannot render ASCII-style directory trees from Markdown lists inside code blocks.

relations.evidence: This plugin relies on the functionality of the dirtreeist library.

summary: Code block renderer that turns Markdown lists in fenced blocks into directory structure diagrams.
